evidence.quote: The spectral synthesis is applied to each spectrum of the data cube, and is performed by a linear combination of the base spectra, in order to fit the observed spectra.

claims.hypothesis: Is there an intermediate-age stellar structure inside the known circumnuclear ring?
claims.experiment: STARLIGHT synthesis over the full GMOS FOV with flux maps per stellar population
claims.result: 1e9 yr population concentrates in a ring of radius ~1 arcsec between nucleus and the circumnuclear ring
claims.finding: An inner circumnuclear ring of intermediate-age stars exists

evidence.quote: allowed the detection, using spectral synthesis methods, of an inner circumnuclear ring

claims.hypothesis: Do gas outflows exist and align with the radio jet and ionization cone?
claims.experiment: Channel maps of Halpha and [O III] in GMOS and SIFS cubes
claims.result: Halpha outflow PA ~17 deg at 306 km/s; [O III] outflows at PA ~43-55 deg and PA ~-10 deg
claims.finding: Three outflow components are detected; Halpha one aligns with the radio jet and one [O III] one with the ionization cone axis

evidence.quote: Three distinct gas outflow components were detected.

claims.hypothesis: Are N1 and N2 parts of the same structure separated by a dust lane?
claims.experiment: Spectral synthesis and pPXF kinematics for N1 and N2
claims.result: No significant differences in populations or stellar velocity
claims.finding: N1 and N2 belong to the same structure

evidence.quote: Such result supports the hypothesis that N1 and N2 are part of the same central structure, apparently separated by a dust lane

claims.hypothesis: Can the age gradient of the H II regions confirm the 'pearls on string' scenario?
claims.experiment: Spectral synthesis of H II regions and ring rotation timescale estimate
claims.result: Ring turn time ~8e6 yr is shorter than the temporal resolution of the spectral synthesis
claims.finding: More precise methods are needed to test the scenario

evidence.quote: we conclude that more precise methods are necessary in order to determine stellar ages in this case, to confirm this scenario.
